title: Estimated due date shows a month + confidence; exact date only if recorded
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test.
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule with a mileage-triggered service and has a mileage reading history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the same estimate shows on the worklist and the work-order panel).
custom_steps:
1. Read an estimated due date and the confidence beneath it.
  2. Confirm an estimate shows a month (not an exact day) at every confidence.
  3. Find a due date that comes from a recorded reading.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every estimated due date shows a month, at every confidence, with its confidence beneath it (High, Medium or Low confidence).
  • A due or overdue service shows its badge and still its month.
  • An exact date belongs to a recorded reading alone.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S11; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R9: “Every estimated due date shows a month, at every confidence, with its confidence beneath it as the meter and a word: High, Medium or Low confidence. The rule that produced it, for example based on mileage estimate, sits in the meter's hover. A due or overdue service shows its badge and still its month. An exact date belongs to a recorded reading alone”
